name: junqi
description: A fullscreen face-up Luzhanqi (军棋) field for ChatGPT. Twenty-five red and twenty-five blue pieces; the model chooses every blue move through tools.

interface.longDescription: iPlugin Junqi is a fullscreen face-up Luzhanqi (军棋) match on the classic 12 × 5 field. You command 25 red pieces from the bottom; ChatGPT commands 25 blue pieces from the top. Every deployment is legal: the flag sits in a headquarters, mines guard the back two rows, bombs avoid the front line, and three engineers start on the railways. Move one step along a road or travel any distance straight along a railway; engineers can turn corners. Camps are safe, headquarters freeze a piece in place, bombs trade with any enemy, engineers defuse mines, and higher ranks win. Capture the enemy flag — or leave the opponent with no legal move — to win. The plugin includes legal-destination hints, road and railway highlighting, battle reports, complete-turn undo, army ledgers, three difficulty levels, an AI First option and confirmed resignation. There is no Junqi engine, opening book or hidden move selector: the model chooses every blue move from the server's legal move list.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start a fullscreen face-up Junqi game and let me move first.
